data.title: 藤原千花 · 晨曦卧房的真丝睡裙慵懒
data.description: 清晨薄纱窗帘后透出明亮的晨曦，千花趴在堆满心形抱枕的粉白大床上。轻薄柔滑的粉色真丝睡裙勾勒出曼妙饱满的曲线，纤细吊带滑落香肩。她揉着惺忪睡眼微微仰起头，白皙双颊泛着娇憨红晕，微翘的嘴角带着刚刚睡醒的甜美撒娇意味。
data.location: cute pastel bedroom filled with heart cushions and plushies
data.action: lying on stomach on luxury pink bedding, thin silk slip dress with straps loose, hugging heart cushion, messy pink hair, sleepy cute blush
data.lighting: soft diffused morning sunbeams pouring into cute bedroom
data.mood: spoiled girlfriend sweetness, heart-melting playful charm
data.promptProse: Lying playfully on her stomach on a pastel bed hugging a plush cushion, Chika Fujiwara wears a delicate pink silk slip nightgown. Her pink hair is pleasantly tousled as she looks up with sleepy, affectionate eyes in the morning sun.
data.animaCaption: Chika lying on her bed in a pink silk slip nightgown, smiling sleepily with bare shoulders.
